purpose: Bounded predictive-performance research; no production promotion
baseline: last eligible completed lap of the same driver
target: same driver's next eligible completed lap after immutable issuance
eligibility: At completed-row timestamp: finite positive LapTime, IsAccurate true, no observed pit-in/out and no TrackStatus 4/5/6/7. No event-wide pace filter. Three cumulative eligible observations before issuance.
availability_assumption: Recorded per-lap accuracy/pit/status fields are treated as available on completed-lap receipt; source files do not prove original vendor publication latency.
stint_reset: Reset local summaries on observed pit-out, compound change, or causal known Stint change. Forward state only; never backward-fill missing Stint.
timestamp_ties: Emit every tied row using other-car state strictly before the entire timestamp batch.
selection: For each mechanism choose minimum event-balanced 2023 MAE, then declare the best mechanism using 2023 only. Refit selected ridge using 2022-2023 once. Report all four selected mechanisms on transfer and exposed data, including losses. No adaptive second cycle.

evaluation.bootstrap_interpretation: event-resampling frequency, not posterior probability; historical transfer is not prospective validation

prefix_regression: All emitted features and mechanism forecasts must be unchanged on real-stream truncations and future-value/quality/stint poisoning, including 2025 Miami missing-Stint data. Check strict other-driver evidence timestamps.
